title: Celestial Dreamweaver
description: A surreal cosmic scene features a large transparent sphere on a golden stand containing a luminous female face with a pink lotus crown, from which a glowing multicolored phoenix emerges. To the right stands a majestic black stag with glowing golden cracks and massive antlers filled with flowers and flames, set against a dramatic sky of clouds and radiating beams of light.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a large transparent crystal sphere on a golden stand containing a serene female face wearing a glowing pink lotus crown, a vibrant phoenix of pink yellow and blue light rising from her head, beside a tall black stag with golden glowing cracks across its body and enormous antlers decorated with flowers and flames, dramatic clouds and radiating beams of colorful light in the background, ethereal and mystical atmosphere
